Hah, you're really cute for a post-apocalyptic scavenger
Well, I think you are quite good-looking too
Thank you, that was a nice compliment, sweetie
Aww, you know, I like you more than canned tuna for breakfast
WHAT?! I BRING YOU GOOD FUCK? Oh... you said "luck"? Sorry, hah...
And you are the "sledge" to my "sledgehammer", babe
Don't you sweet-talk me like this, babe. I still won't do your laundry
Hah, that was clever. Where did you learn that sweet talk? From zombies?
You are sweet as a strawberry and spicy like a chili, aren't you?
Thanks, my turn now - are you a stir-fry? Cause you are hot. Ugh, that was bad...
Hah, well, I hope you don't say that to every other survivor
Well, aren't you a sweet zombie-killer, huh?
Wait - do you hear that? We're not alone.
Zombies! Get up, get up!
Now that was a proper... exercise, haha
Wow, where did you get that stamina? From running from zombies?
Damn, you weren't lying... that really was a good stress relief
Fuck, that was amazing, I feel like I just got back from some three-day-long scavenging mission
We should do that again soon, don't you think?
Now that was a good break from zombie killing!
Thank you! I will take good care of it
Wow, you didn't have to, thanks
Is it for me? Wow, you are really sweet for a zombie-killer
Woah, no way... how did you know I wanted that? Thanks!
A gift for me? Thank you, I love it!
Well, aren't you cute, thank you
Wow, it's amazing! Where did you find it? Or maybe I shouldn't know...
Aww, that's really nice of you, thanks
A gift? Hmm, well, thanks I guess
I, um... I am sorry, but I don't really know how I could use it
Well, it's the thought that counts
Well, I appreciate the thought, but... this? Really?
Thanks, but this gift kinda sucks, babe, not gonna lie
This thing? How am I supposed to use it?
Alright. Got it. I'll head over to the base.
I used to love Romero movies... I can't enjoy them anymore.
♪♪♪ (whistling)
Did you hear the screaming last night? No? Then never mind.
Dead, but not dead. Strange, isn't it?
Must be the wind. The stench is awful today.
Ever been to Texas? It was more dangerous than this place.
You hear that? They say Osaka, Japan managed to quarantine itself.
Chemicals, viruses, aliens... what do you think caused this?
So this is The Last Man on Earth, huh?
After a fight, that's when I get scared. You'll believe me if I say I wasn't bitten, right?
If you get bitten, don't hide it. That's how communities fall apart.
I dream about killing people I loved. I wish it had only been a dream.
Believe it or not, they used to call me "Mad."
I'm done being a zombie movie fan. I'm switching to shark movies.
Don't wear headphones. You'll get bitten from behind.
If this pandemic ever ends... no, I won't say the rest.
Let's not start fighting each other, alright? That's the boring part of the story.
I saw it. The day before this started, something came down from the sky... never mind.
FUBAR... yeah, FUBAR.
Oh, it's you. Thought you were a zombie.
I once killed three zombies with one bullet. You don't believe me, do you?
I once killed three zombies with one swing. That one's a lie.
Don't get careless. If you do, I can't afford to.
Zombies don't have anywhere to go either. That's why they wander around.
What do we call them? Zombies? Undead? Infected?
There's a game I never finished. I want to go get it someday.
Shoot. Swing. The world's gotten real simple.
Should've prepared a mohawk and spiked shoulder pads.
Rumor says the military's gathering in California. Rumor says.
You think this is God's test?
When there's no more room in Hell, huh?
You only realize how good it is to have people around when you're alone.
This is the first time I've ever been grateful for gun culture.
Thanks for letting me join you. Just... don't kick me out, alright?
Do you count your shots? You should.
Check your gear before we head out. You always forget something.
The world's gone to hell, but sometimes... sometimes it's still kind of fun.
We smell almost as bad as they do.
I want something sweet. Something spicy, too...
Dun-dun-dun-dun-dun... dun-dun-dun-dun-dun...
Da-dum... da-dum... da-da-da-da...
We should burn the bodies. Sorry, Jesus, but we can't have them coming back.
I'm worried about my cousin. Knowing him, he might be eating the zombies instead.
I'm looking for a friend I got separated from. I hope I don't find them in the horde.
Cough! Cough! ...What? It's just a cough.
I saw a zombie holding a sign that said "Zombie Rights."
I once saw a drunk walking with a pack of zombies.
You're the leader. Keep it together.
I heard a zombie bit Chuck Norris, suffered for a while, then died.
Their teeth can bite through clothes. Be careful.
Someone who used to mock me died. Strangely enough, I was sad.
Someone stopped by earlier. They were already dead, so I killed them.
That thing you ate yesterday... no, I won't say it.
A zombie bit me once, but it had dentures. Lucky me.
I hear some people are trying to control the zombies.
I can't name every president, but I know the next one. A zombie.
If we held an election now, the zombies would win.
I think zombies still carry habits from when they were alive.
Think there are vegetarian zombies?
Maybe their goal isn't to eat us. Maybe it's to make more of themselves.
There's no Superman. No Batman. So we have to fight.
I've thought "this is it" a hundred times. Still here.
I've become prejudiced against zombies. Funny thing is, we're the minority now.
What's your favorite gun? ...That's a pretty old-school choice.
What's your favorite food? ...Seriously? Ugh.
What's your favorite movie? ...Didn't expect that. You watch that kind of thing?
What's your favorite comic? ...Yeah, that's a cool one.
Who taught you to shoot? Bruce Willis?
That swing of yours is something else. Babe Ruth reincarnated, maybe?
You're a good person. So I'll try to be one too.
I still haven't gotten used to the feeling of cutting a zombie with a knife.
I like crushing zombie heads. Splat!
I'm fine with bringing in more people, but choose carefully.
There were crows gathering in the woods. Means there's a body out there.
Did you see a helicopter in the distance? No? ...Right.
Someone said they saw a ten-foot zombie. Probably just saw wrong.
I heard about a guy who walked straight through a horde. Then one day he tripped and died.
Got any funny stories? ...Yeah, I heard that one already.
Got any funny stories? ...Never heard that one. Don't care, though.
Got any funny stories? ...Ha! No, wait. It wasn't that funny.
There was a pebble in my shoe. It's always the little things that ruin your life.
Sometimes there are smart ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
Sometimes there are fast ones mixed in with the zombies. Don't get careless.
Aim for the head. Not mine. The zombie's.
Head's worth 100 points, torso's 50, arms are 20. Sound fair?
I heard survivors are gathering at the Gigamart. Zombies too, obviously.
If you die, I die too.
Cats or dogs? ...Huh. So that's your answer.
This place might be worse than medieval London.
Sometimes I wonder if they're really dead.
Don't try to be a hero. You'll die.
Maybe we're all standing on the edge between life and death. Us and them.
A .44's the way to go. Dirty Harry carried one.
Careful. This is the Wild West now.
Bang! Bang! Bang! How's my quick draw?
Ever been to the West Coast? I haven't. Let's drive there someday.
They say in Heaven, everybody talks about the ocean.
If it comes down to it, leave me behind. I won't leave you, though.
Guess we're back to the frontier days. Want to plant an apple tree?
I once shot at someone thinking they were a zombie. Good thing I missed.
I'm tired... I can't remember the last time I wasn't.
When I wake up, the first thing I do is check my hands.
I can eat meat in the middle of that rotten stink now.
Choose the base location carefully. Please don't build it in the middle of a desert.
The night is too quiet. Put on some club music or something.
I once knew a guy who put poisonous mushrooms in a stew. You be careful too.
Do you know what bleach tastes like? I don't want to.
Drive safely, all right? I'd hate to die in some stupid car crash.
Someone said they saw a zombie climbing up the wall of a building. You believe that?
If you want to survive, make rules.
Darkness, corners... those things are good at hiding their presence.
Look around before throwing bombs. Don't blow up the house, okay?
Burning zombies are dangerous. They keep walking while they're on fire.
Someone said they saw a zombie dodge bullets. You believe that?
Someone said they saw a zombie with no head. You believe that?
If you've got time, load some rounds into the magazines.
Was that you banging on the wall last night?
Shotguns are powerful, but they call in a lot of zombies. Don't use them at the wrong time.
Magazines everywhere and no gun! Should we throw the magazines at them?
Don't forget to turn off your flashlight.
The sole of your boot is the strongest weapon.
Splitting a zombie's head open in one hit is harder than it looks. There's a trick to it.
When you use a knife, don't carve them up. Drive it in with one clean thrust.
If I turn into a zombie, then when that time comes... let's become zombies together, yeah?
You're marking things on the map, right? Don't get lost.
I hate the cold, and I hate the heat.
Darkness is their playing field.
Keep your eyes on the road when you're driving, okay?
I heard the Navy is taking survivors to some island.
How many zombies have you killed so far? Me... I stopped counting.
There was a Japanese guy fighting zombies with a katana. In the end, he died by seppuku.
Listen, don't ever sneak up behind me. I might kill you by accident.
I saw a rich guy get attacked and shove a wad of cash into a zombie's mouth before beating it to death.
Even when civilization ends, some things never change.
I saw a preacher trying to enlighten a zombie. The zombie listened for a while... then bit him.
Only open canned food when you're ready to eat it. It'll spoil.
Don't say it's just your imagination. If something feels off, check it.
One day, a bomb might fall and end everything... maybe that day will come.
Collect books for me. I get bored when we're at the base.
Persistent bastards. They follow you anywhere.
Apparently they can't swim. They won't come into the river. Well, neither can we...
Don't look for romance in a gun. This is real combat.
At least we probably don't have to worry about World War III anymore.
Which are you better with, knives or guns? ...I see. So that's why you're so bad.
A chef is absolutely necessary. Food rules everything.
There were so many things I wanted to do before all this... guess that's not happening now.
Put some seasoning in the food, will you? I hate tasteless meals.
Sometimes I feel like pointing the barrel at myself instead of the zombies.
I'm glad there aren't zombies running at us with bombs strapped to their bodies.
Building a home means being ready to fight for it.
There's something I always keep with me... wait, where did it go?
I'm on cooking duty today. You don't have any picky eating habits, right?
There's a zombie corpse lying around. Put it out on garbage day, will you?
If you find batteries, bring them back. I want to play my Game Boy.
Damn it, I just remembered I returned a video without rewinding it.
All right, watch up, down, front, back, left, and right. I'll have a smoke.
Hey, you're not hiding cigarettes from me, are you?
Whatever happens, don't panic. That 0.1 second can be what kills you.
I just saw an insanely beautiful woman... she was a zombie.
That zombie I saw the other day was that famous... no? Oh. Never mind.
In this world of slowpokes, I'm Carl Lewis.
Under the bed, inside the closet, in the back seat... they can be anywhere, so stay sharp.
Let me drive next time. My license got revoked, but still.
That whiskey you hid under the bed? Sorry, I drank it.
I keep one bullet in my pocket... you know why, right?
Don't run too much. You'll trip.
You brought the travel itinerary, right?
Where are we headed today? Disneyland?
I keep dreaming that I wake up inside a coffin.
They can see in the dark. Even if we can't see them, they can see us.
That blood on you... oh, it's just zombie blood.
It's easy to blame someone. Easy, and that's all.
Luckily, our group doesn't fight with each other. Lucky us.
Left or right... it's always a tough choice.
They say meat tastes better when it's almost rotten, right?
Once, I ate a huge hamburger and my jaw popped out. How do those things keep theirs attached?
A doctor is absolutely necessary. A doctor who isn't a zombie, I mean.
Don't stick your muzzle out around a corner. Basic room clearing.
We're the Zombie Busters, right?
Let's play chess sometime. The rules? We'll make them up.
Let's play poker sometime with the cards I made.
Give me a better house, will you? Something like the White House.
If you find a tank, tell me. I always wanted to ride one.
Don't get careless just because we have walls. Everything has a lifespan.
Always stay cool. That's how you survive.
Walk quietly. Like a cat, like a ninja...
Watch out for smells too, not just sounds... What? Your nose is stuffed and you can't smell anything?
The people back at base bring in all kinds of items. Check on them once in a while.
I won't fight if you're not nearby, so keep that in mind.
Are you organizing the containers properly? I found a gun in the fridge.
Are you organizing the containers properly? I found food in the armory.
Could you please stop cooking with the same frying pan you used to beat a zombie?
There's a dessert on the shelf. A Desert Eagle, I mean.
Put curtains on the windows, will you? I can't relax like this.
Please don't make this place a house made of nothing but containers.
Please don't make this place a square box of a house.
Stop leaving every damn thing on the floor.
Don't go out on rainy days. It covers up every sign of the zombies.
Dry your wet clothes properly. You'll catch a cold.
Sorry, I'm bad at locking up.
Thanks for having me. I'll follow your lead.
I don't want to be alone. Please don't leave me behind.
They're chasing me! Help me!
Please, take me with you. I swear I'll be useful.
Let me join you, please.
I can fight and scavenge. I won't be a burden.

Base Healing Amount (Doctor)

Base Radius: Large

Base Radius: Medium

Base Radius: Small
Radius in tiles for a small base.
Base Structure Repair Amount
Health restored to each damaged door, window, or barricade per repair interval. This stacks with the number of repairmen assigned to the base.
Base Structure Repair Interval (Hours)
How often repairmen repair damaged base doors, windows, and barricades.
Collection Storage Capacity
The maximum weight capacity of the shared NPC collection storage. Default is 500, maximum is 1000.
Companion: Infinite Ammo
If checked, NPCs will not consume ammo from their inventory while they are companions.

Enable Debug Menu
If checked, the NotAlone NPC debug menu will be available in the context menu.
Farming Care Interval (Hours)
How often farmers water crops in the base.
Farming Care Water Amount
Water added to each crop per farming care interval. Applied in 5-unit watering actions to match the game's farming command. Default is 100.
Wanderer Spawn Chance (%%)
The chance for wanderer NPCs to spawn around the player.
Wanderer Spawn Cooldown After Success (Hours)
How long to pause wanderer spawn checks after a wanderer group successfully spawns. Set to 0 to disable.
Wanderer Spawn Interval (Minutes)
How often the game attempts to spawn wanderer NPCs.
Wanderer Max Groups
The maximum number of wanderer NPC groups that can be active at the same time.
Firefighter Rain Barrel Water Amount
Water added to each rain collector barrel per interval. This stacks with the number of fire officers assigned to the base.
Firefighter Rain Barrel Interval (Hours)
How often fire officers assigned to a base add water to rain collector barrels in that base.
Generator Care Interval (Hours)
How often electricians and engineers maintain generators in the base.
Generator Fuel Amount
Fuel amount added per generator each interval. This stacks with the number of electricians and engineers assigned to the base.
Generator Repair Amount
Condition amount repaired per generator each interval. This stacks with the number of electricians and engineers assigned to the base.
Max Community Size
The maximum total number of community NPCs, including base members and companions.
Max Companions
The maximum number of companion NPCs that can follow you at the same time.
NPC Conversation Cooldown (Minutes)
How long before the same NPC can provide conversation relief again. Set to 0 for no cooldown.
NPC Conversation Relief Amount
How much stress, boredom, and unhappiness are reduced when talking with an NPC. Stress is reduced as a percent; boredom and unhappiness are reduced as values.
NPC Door Closing Delay (Seconds)
Delay before an NPC closes a nearby door after passing through it.

Vehicle Repair Interval (Hours)
How often mechanics repair vehicles in the base.
